skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — combine my clips, add background music, and export as MP4 — and get polish...

latestVersion.changelog:
video-maker-free-for-pc 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly create and export videos online by uploading clips or images, no installation required.
- Free, automatic session and token handling for new users with up to 100 credits for 7 days.
- Supports major formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (files up to 500MB), plus audio and image formats.
- Includes cloud rendering for quick turnaround (1–2 minutes for short clips), exporting ready-to-download MP4 files.
- Simple prompts and automated workflows—ideal for beginners or anyone wanting fast, polished results on PC.
